transactions.description: Period aggregate: outbound and prepaid return travel

accounting: Opening authority and capital ceiling are separate. Only actual expenditure counts as expense; undrawn authority is not cash. Released but unspent capital remains restricted Crown cash. No personal or household transfer.

capital.funding: Staged Crown reserve-backed capital appropriation. Treasury-to-project transfer is not itself a national expense; actual construction expense is reconciled once in the current national reserve bridge. No duplicate charge to ordinary defence envelopes.
capital.cost_scope: Prior 11m preliminary complex plus 2.2m railway/underground access additions and 0.8m expanded protection/airstrip allowances; revised ceiling not a fixed final tender.
